metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-14. - Collection of assessment and foreclosure.
content.summary:
In the event the assessment is not paid, collection of the assessment may be handled
               pursuant to the provisions of
chapter 59
entitled "Municipal Liens."
(
Ord. No. 4098, § 2, 11-19-2007
)
